name: GDSR
description: Browse, play and rate GDSR songs, review requests and send levels and songs from the game

show-button.name: Show GDSR button
show-button.description: Show the GDSR button on level pages.

use-jukebox.name: Use Jukebox songs
use-jukebox.description: If you picked a song for a level with Jukebox, upload that song instead of the original one.

auto-jukebox.name: Auto-add Jukebox songs (admins)
auto-jukebox.description: When you open GDSR on a level page, add the Jukebox NONGs for the level's songs to GDSR, including songs listed in your Jukebox indexes that you haven't downloaded. Songs already on GDSR are skipped.

show-menu-button.name: Show GDSR in the main menu
show-menu-button.description: Adds a GDSR button to the bottom row of the main menu.

player-volume.name: Player volume
player-volume.description: Volume for songs played by GDSR (the menu music pauses while they play).
